messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: streaming p99 latency spike detected in prod-west at 2026-06-14 09:40 UTC. metric: stream.p99=3.8s (SLO 1.2s). model=redwood-03 (A100 pool). paging: oncall-sre. incident: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-20260614-1781516400

alex: acked — grabbing metrics, recent deploys, and logs. any customer 5xxs?

maria: noticing stream stalls + gateway 502s. p95 ~610ms, p99 ~3.8s, error rate ~0.9%. started ~09:36 UTC. deploy-bot shows no prod-west deploys in last hour.

jon: node telemetry points to gw-west-2b-021. ECC correctable counts climbing, thermald warnings. nvidia kernel messages present. tagging @hw-oncall.

sre-bot: @alex please run mitigation: /inc mitigation --name cold-fallback --pct 20 --scope prod-west

alex: executed mitigation. routing 20% of traffic to model-redwood-01-small. monitoring tail latency.

maria: p99 dropped to ~2.2s with 20% fallback, still above SLO for sessions >2048 tokens. stalls reduced but tail remains problematic.

jon: ssh'd into gw-west-2b-021. journal excerpt:
```
Jun 14 09:37:05 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:66:00): 79, GPC stall
Jun 14 09:37:30 kernel: nvidia: GPU0 ECC correctable error count increased to 142
Jun 14 09:38:05 thermald[1420]: GPU0 temp spike 91C -> thermal throttle
```
Memory bandwidth is saturated during bursts; KV-cache swap churn is high.

hw-oncall: acknowledged. cordon and drain that host for hardware triage. I'll start diagnostics and prepare RMA if uncorrectable errors persist.

alex: starting drain: `kubectl drain gw-west-2b-021 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=12m`

maria: enabling KV-cache bypass for very-long contexts to reduce swap churn: `/ops feature-toggle set kv_bypass_long_ctx=on --env=prod-west`

sre-bot: autoscaler: provisioning +2 A100 nodes in prod-west to handle migration. ETA ~4m.

jon: during drain we saw grpc-sidecar resets (~30 sessions) with "stream reset by peer"; kernel copy stalls correlated with NVRM messages.

alex: CUSTOMER-IMPACT: Two enterprise customers in prod-west may see degraded tail latency on streaming sessions >2048 tokens. CS notified.

cs-rep: notified affected customers with mitigation guidance (chunk smaller, reduce streaming window). waiting on replies; no escalations so far.

hw-oncall: quick nv-diag run shows rising correctable ECC counts and a couple transient U errors that recovered on retry. keeping node drained; will RMA if U errors recur.

maria: after scale + fallback + kv-bypass, p99 is ~1.12s and p95 ~380ms. holding to observe for 30 minutes.

jon: thermald still reports spikes under sustained >80% GPU load — suspect fan degradation or degraded thermal interface. opening infra ticket for on-site inspection.

alex: escalation plan if tail regresses: 1) increase fallback to 50% 2) enable cross-region spill to prod-east 3) enable CPU fallback for low-priority customers. Command: `/inc mitigation --name fallback-50`

sre-bot: mitigation `fallback-50` applied. routing adjusted accordingly.

maria: post-mitigation snapshot: p95=370ms, p99=980ms (within SLO). 5xxs down to 0.2%. streaming stall rate decreased ~80%.

cs-rep: customers confirm improved experience. marking incident state as MONITORING.

hw-oncall: submitted RMA for gw-west-2b-021 GPU unit. RMA ticket HWT-20260614-9007, ETA 48-72h. recommend leaving node drained until replacement.

jon: annotating node metadata: hardware_status=degraded; reason=\"ECC correctable burst + thermal throttle\"; hw_ticket=HWT-20260614-9007

alex: creating incident document and action items. assigning postmortem to eng-runtime + infra. postmortem link: https://redwood.ops/postmortems/INC-20260614-1781516400

maria: request: tune ECC-correctable alert threshold to 50 events / 10m for streaming clusters (current threshold was 100).

sre-bot: created task ALERT-TUNING-439.

cs-rep: tenants appreciate proactive comms. incident state -> MONITORING.

alex: final update: node drained & offlined at 09:51 UTC, p99 stayed <1s for 25 minutes. moving to MONITORING. will run blameless postmortem in 48h and update runbooks (auto-fallback sooner, ECC early-warning, KV heuristics).

hw-oncall: recommend improving thermal telemetry (per-GPU fan RPM, inlet temps) and rack airflow check during RMA.

sre-bot: INCIDENT STATE: MONITORING — next update in 2h or on regression.

alex: thanks all — closing thread to reduce noise; will reopen on any regression. :thumbsup:

maria: adding runbook checklist: alert tuning, fallback thresholds, KV-cache heuristics, infra replacement steps.

jon: quick repro for eng to simulate long-seq streaming load in staging:
```
ab -n 200 -c 10 -p long_stream_payload.json https://staging.redwood/stream?model=redwood-03
# payload ~3200 token chunks
```

ops-bot: Incident INC-20260614-1781516400 moved to MONITORING by alex at 2026-06-14 09:53 UTC
